problem:
Consider the following vectors:

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Assume that ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},$ and ${x}_{3}$ are real numbers. Which of the following statements are true?

- The vectors ${a}_{1},{a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{3}$ are linearly dependent.
- The equation ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=0$ has only the trivial solution ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$
- The vectors ${a}_{1},{a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{3}$ are linearly independent.

choices.value: None of the statements are true
